issue_request: FHIR-12382 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Encounter issue raised against DSTU2. It reported that the encounter-relatedCondition extension definition showed both a root valueReference and child extensions, which should not be allowed, and asked for automated validation to detect that pattern.

Git history shows the directly matching application as 035362eee26ecc29f555fa60b2e02191aedcb77e, '#12382 - validate extensions', which added ExtensionDefinitionValidator and invoked it from SpreadsheetParser so generated extension definitions could not have both a root value and child extensions.

The current active source has no encounter-relatedCondition definition in source/ or the FHIR Extension Pack checkout, source/fhir.ini does not reference release2/tools-history artifacts, and the current Extension datatype plus extensibility narrative state the value-or-subextensions rule. The historical source/release2 conformance artifacts were removed from the active build by 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. A scan of current core and extension-pack StructureDefinitions found zero extension definitions with both a non-zero root value[x] and non-zero child extension slices, so there was no active source defect to correct.
